spoken_script: Meta and Stripe just built the official internet protocol for AI agents. Meta and Sierra unveiled the Personal Agent Protocol, an open standard built on OAuth. Instead of chaotic web scraping, autonomous AI agents now authenticate directly with businesses using verified digital handshakes. Users grant granular permissions, from browsing inventory to authorizing live checkouts. Backed by Walmart, Shopify, and Stripe, the agentic web just got its official standard.
